notes:
- Preferences dialog redesigned: separate tabs for settings and tool tiles, with a status strip and improved update pill
- Tool tiles now support tooltips with a body description
- AutoSync settings use a toggle pill instead of a checkbox
- PillToggle style is now shared across dialogs
- Tool tiles can be individually shown/hidden from the ToolCatalog
- Updater is more reliable: mutex guard prevents duplicate runs, version check before applying, and shows a result message
